cn_title: 乐高预告将于2027年推出耀西套装
opus_summary: 任天堂预告了一款全新的乐高Yoshi套装，展示了由塑料积木拼成的Yoshi面部。该套装属于《超级马力欧》系列，预告面向成年人的措辞暗示其可能是用于展示的复杂套装。价格和发售日期尚未公布，但根据版权信息，预计将于2027年初推出。

paragraphs.en: Nintendo has teased a new LEGO Yoshi set.
paragraphs.cn: 任天堂预告了一款全新的乐高耀西套装。

paragraphs.en: A news update posted to the Nintendo Today! app on Monday, November 9 is labelled "New LEGO Super Mario Set Hatching Soon," with the subtitle "Adults Welcome." Clicking into the post reveals a full chunk of Yoshi’s face in plastic brick form.
paragraphs.cn: 11月9日星期一，任天堂Today!应用发布的一则新闻动态标题为「全新乐高超级马力欧套装即将孵化」，副标题为「欢迎成年人」。点击帖子后，可以看到用塑料积木拼成的耀西脸部的一大块。

paragraphs.en: The teaser confirms that the set is a new addition to the Super Mario theme, owing to the rideable dinosaur’s debut in Super Mario World. However, the 'adult' focus of the teaser suggests the Super Mario line is branching out into more complex sets built for display.
paragraphs.cn: 预告确认这款套装是超级马力欧主题的新品，因为这种可供骑乘的恐龙首次登场于《超级马力欧世界》。不过，预告对「成年人」的强调表明，超级马力欧系列正在拓展至更复杂、用于展示的套装。

paragraphs.en: There’s no word on pricing or release date, but based on the copyright information, we expect LEGO Yoshi to release in early 2027.
paragraphs.cn: 目前尚无价格或发售日期的消息，但根据版权信息，我们预计乐高耀西将于2027年初发售。

paragraphs.en: The LEGO Super Mario theme currently has about 20 sets in rotation , but well over 100 sets have been released since the lined first debuted in 2020. The previously released LEGO Mario & Yoshi set , which evokes a retro pixel art look, is set to join the most of those sets in retirement this December. Apparently LEGO can only handle own Yoshi at a time.
paragraphs.cn: 乐高超级马力欧主题目前约有20款套装在售，但自该系列于2020年首次推出以来，已经发售了远超100款套装。此前推出的乐高马力欧与耀西套装呈现出复古像素艺术风格，将于今年12月停产，加入这些套装中大多数的行列。显然，乐高一次只能应付一个耀西。

paragraphs.en: The Super Mario theme has generally stuck to the old-school ethos of being built for interactive play, the bulk made up of smaller sets with one or two minifigures. In recent years, however, the company has branched out with larger decorative builds for adult fans.
paragraphs.cn: 超级马力欧主题总体上一直遵循为互动玩耍而打造的传统理念，大部分产品都是配有一两个小人仔的小型套装。不过近年来，该公司拓展了产品范围，为成年粉丝推出更大型的装饰性拼搭套装。

paragraphs.en: I think it’s safe to say we’re looking at a giant LEGO Yoshi, which falls into the latter category. The closest approximation that currently exists in the Super Mario line is the Mario Kart sets dedicated to Mario and Luigi, priced at $179.99 and $169.99, respectively.
paragraphs.cn: 我认为可以有把握地说，我们看到的是一个巨型乐高耀西，属于后一类。目前超级马力欧系列中最接近的是以马力欧和路易吉为主题的马力欧卡丁车套装，售价分别为179.99美元和169.99美元。

paragraphs.en: While LEGO generally sticks to modern depictions of the Super Mario characters, the company has also experimented with sets like the LEGO Donkey Kong Arcade . The 'hatching' reference may just be for marketing’s sake, but it would be cool to see LEGO try and replicate something like the Hatchin Yoshi toy that was released alongside The Super Mario Galaxy Movie .
paragraphs.cn: 虽然乐高通常采用超级马力欧角色的现代形象，但该公司也尝试过乐高Donkey Kong Arcade之类的套装。提到「孵化」可能只是出于营销目的，但如果能看到乐高尝试复现与《The超级马力欧Galaxy Movie》一同推出的Hatchin Yoshi玩具之类的东西，那会很酷。

paragraphs.en: Like Nintendo, LEGO is generally trying to balance its appeal across generations with different 'levels' of sets. The LEGO Pokemon theme , for example, originally launched with three massive and particularly expensive builds dedicated to individual pocket monsters. A year later, the toy company released more than a dozen smaller (and cheaper) Pokemon sets using its new Smart Play technology . The strategy generally feels like "here’s one for the adults," then "here’s some for the kids."
paragraphs.cn: 与任天堂一样，乐高总体上也在尝试通过不同「级别」的套装，平衡其对不同世代的吸引力。例如，乐高宝可梦主题最初推出了三款体型巨大、价格尤其昂贵的拼搭套装，每款以一只宝可梦为主题。一年后，这家玩具公司利用其新的Smart Play技术，推出了十多款较小（也较便宜）的宝可梦套装。这一策略整体上给人的感觉是先说「这是给大人的」，然后再说「这些是给孩子的」。

paragraphs.en: The challenge with the more adult-focused sets is they’re significantly more expensive. LEGO uses a relatively standard "price ber brick" model for its sets, which have only gotten bigger with time . Still, the strategy seems to be working well for LEGO, who reported record-breaking revenue in the first half of 2026.
paragraphs.cn: 更侧重成年人的套装面临的挑战是，它们要贵得多。乐高套装采用相对标准的「按积木块数定价」模式，而套装随着时间推移变得越来越大。尽管如此，这一策略对乐高似乎颇为奏效，该公司报告称其2026年上半年的营收创下了纪录。
